text:
alex: Heads-up — partner onboarding checklist for CloudCo templates. Need a short list of must-have items before we hand off TF modules to their engineering team.
maya: High level ok. can we require a smoke test + a conformance checklist? keeps support calls down.
tom: +1. suggest these pieces: module examples, minimal CI (lint/plan), smoke deploy script, and a matrix of supported regions/machine types.
alex: exact proposal in thread: 1) single-file example for aws/gcp/azure 2) CI job that runs `terraform init && terraform plan` 3) smoke deploy that brings up a small inference stack (1 replica) 4) conformance tests (outputs + latency spike check)
lia: sounds good. For the smoke stack, should we include an option to use either Graviton or Ampere images? hardware partners will ask.
jordan: yes — add `instance_type` variable with allowed list. CloudCo asked for ARM support; they'd like a quick path to test on Graviton.
maya: also add a quick troubleshooting section: common error patterns and how to interpret `terraform apply` failures. saves time.
alex: good call. i'll draft the template. quick module usage snippet for the README:
```hcl
module "redwood_inference" {
  source = "./modules/llm-serving"
  cloud  = "aws"
  region = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = var.instance_type # e.g. c6i.large or m6g.large
}
```
tom: can we also include a small `smoke.sh` that runs a healthcheck against the service endpoint and asserts 200 + latency < 500ms? partners like deterministic checks.
lia: yea add `export EXPECT_LATENCY_MS=500` and fail CI if > that.
cloud_partner_bot: [auto] Created ticket CP-4821: partner-template-conformance for CloudCo. Assigned to alex, due in 2 weeks.
alex: thanks bot. timeline: draft PR in 3 days, review with partner week after, CI gating enabled before handoff.
maya: tagging @support for runbook draft after PR lands.
jordan: will pair on the ARM images testing next Tue. ping me.
alex: great — i'll open the branch and drop the initial checklist + links to the CI template. will update this thread with PR link. :thumbsup:
